name: quantumvault-uml
description: Generates a UML class diagram from Assets/Scripts. Static build for Cloudflare Pages, plus a local live-reload server.
comment: These dependencies are for the LOCAL LIVE SERVER only. The Cloudflare build runs `node Tools/uml/build.js`, which uses nothing but Node builtins. This file deliberately lives here rather than at the repo root so Pages finds no manifest and skips npm install entirely.
